gateConfig.title: Gate Config
gateConfig.lostWhileJoining: Lost contact with the gate while joining {ssid}. That is expected if you were connected to its hotspot — reconnect to {ssid} and reopen this page. If the gate cannot join, it raises its hotspot again within a minute.
gateConfig.resetText: The gate forgets every saved network and starts its own hotspot. Join that hotspot to reach this page again.
gateConfig.lostAfterReset: Lost contact with the gate — expected: it left this network. Join its hotspot to reach this page again.
gateConfig.shutDownText: It has to be switched back on by hand.
gateConfig.shuttingDown: Shutting down. Wait until the green LED on the Pi has stopped flashing (about 10 seconds), then disconnect power.
gateConfig.notSaved: Nothing was saved — check the fields below.
gateConfig.gateIdChanged: Changing the Gate ID makes this a different gate to the server. Its existing assignment and recorded detections stay with the old ID.
gateConfig.noNetworkManager: NetworkManager is not available on this machine, so Wi-Fi cannot be configured from here. Expected off a Raspberry Pi, or on a gate wired by Ethernet.
gateConfig.networkHint: Pick one in range, or type the name of a hidden network.
gateConfig.wifiPasswordHint: Stored by NetworkManager, not in the gate's config file.
gateConfig.onHotspot: You are connected to this gate's own hotspot. Joining a network takes the hotspot down, so this page will go unreachable — that is expected. If the gate cannot join, it raises the hotspot again within a minute.

wifiError.ssidMissing: Pick a network or type its name.
wifiError.ssidTooLong: Network names are at most 32 bytes.
wifiError.passwordInvalid: Wi-Fi passwords are 8 to 63 printable characters.

GATE_ID.label: Gate ID
GATE_ID.message: Use letters, digits, underscore and hyphen only (max 64).
GATE_ID.hint: Identity on the server — changing it makes the old one a separate gate.

MQTT_HOST.label: rally-server address
MQTT_HOST.message: Use a host name or IP address.
MQTT_HOST.hint: Default rally-server.local is discovered over mDNS; an address here overrides it.

MQTT_PORT.label: MQTT port
MQTT_PORT.message: Must be a port between 1 and 65535.

ADAPTER.label: Decoder
ADAPTER.message: Pick one of the listed decoders.
ADAPTER.hint: beam: a light barrier on a GPIO pin — times passings, a marshal assigns the car.

BEAM_GPIO.label: Light barrier GPIO
BEAM_GPIO.message: A GPIO line name, e.g. GPIO17.
BEAM_GPIO.hint: BCM name of the pin the sensor output is wired to. Default GPIO17.

BEAM_EDGE.label: Light barrier trigger edge
BEAM_EDGE.hint: Which edge means "beam broken" — depends on the sensor Light-ON/Dark-ON setting. Default rising.

BEAM_LOCKOUT_MS.label: Light barrier lockout (ms)
BEAM_LOCKOUT_MS.hint: Further triggers within this time count as the same car. Default 500.

TRANSPONDERS.label: Simulated transponders
TRANSPONDERS.hint: Transponder ids the simulator cycles through.

SIMULATE_INTERVAL_MS.label: Simulated interval (ms)
SIMULATE_INTERVAL_MS.hint: Leave empty to publish no simulated detections.

HOTSPOT_PASSWORD.label: Hotspot password
HOTSPOT_PASSWORD.hint: For the rally-gate-‹hostname› network this gate raises when it can reach no Wi-Fi. Default rally-gate.

HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS.label: Heartbeat interval (ms)
HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS.hint: Default 15000. Slower than 30000 and the server reads this gate as offline.
